plugin.name: Deep Connect
plugin.description: Opens Termix sessions from URLs (built for Lansweeper asset links): connects saved hosts or ad-hoc addresses over SSH, RDP or VNC, with a confirm before every connect.

tab.title: Connect from link
tab.empty: Paste a connect link in your browser to use this view.

handoff.cancelled: Connect cancelled. The link was cleared.
handoff.noPayload: No connect link in this URL.
handoff.noPlugin: This link asks for a connection type this view cannot finish: no plugin provides a session for it, and no saved record can be created for it.
handoff.adoptNote: If {{host}} is a new address, this also saves it in the Ad-Hoc Hosts folder with credential {{name}} referenced, so the link keeps working.
handoff.finishSaved: The record for {{host}} exists. Open Termix and connect — this page cannot open sessions (Termix requires its shell).
handoff.finishAdopted: Saved as {{host}} in Termix — connect from the Hosts list. This page cannot open sessions (Termix requires its shell).
handoff.cannotAdoptTitle: This link cannot finish on this page
handoff.cannotAdopt: The link carries no saved credential to attach, and Termix's plugin frames open sessions by saved host id only. Nothing can be saved or opened here — Open Termix and connect there.
handoff.noSurfaceTitle: This page cannot reach the Termix app
handoff.noSurface: The app surface this page needs is unavailable, so the link can neither be resolved nor saved — nothing was opened or written. Open Termix and connect there.
handoff.adoptFailed: The save request failed, so nothing was saved and nothing was opened. Try the link again, or connect from the Termix app.
handoff.connectFailedHint: Nothing was opened and no new window will be launched. Try the link again, or connect from the Termix app.

deepLink.confirmDescription: A session for {{host}} opens in a new tab.
deepLink.hostCredentialNote: The session rides the credentials saved on the host record.
deepLink.adhocCredentialNote: {{name}} will be asked for in the session (saved credentials cannot be carried on ad-hoc {{protocol}} links yet).
deepLink.adoptDescription: Create a saved host named {{host}} in the Ad-Hoc Hosts folder with credential {{name}} attached, then connect to it. The host record keeps this link working from now on; the credential is referenced, never read.
deepLink.adoptCreated: Host {{host}} created in the Ad-Hoc Hosts folder.
deepLink.adoptUnavailable: Could not create the host; the ad-hoc session opens instead.
deepLink.adoptUpdateDescription: This link needs {{protocol}} on the existing host {{host}}: adds the connection using credential {{name}} (referenced, never read), then connects.
deepLink.viewOnlyNote: The link asks for view only: the session opens without input controls.
deepLink.viewOnlySavedNote: The link asks for view only; Termix opens it normally in this version.
deepLink.connectFailed: No connection could be opened for this link.

use.title: Use Deep Connect
use.description: Open Termix sessions from Lansweeper asset links.
